name: Kroger Grocery Distribution Center Indianapolis IN

fieldNotes.truckGate: Signalized entrance off English Ave leads to an interior guarded checkpoint ~70m inside the property: gate island with booth and a clearly visible lift/boom arm across the lane (z21 imagery).
fieldNotes.guardShack: Single small ~1-vehicle-footprint booth on the median island between the inbound and outbound lanes at the interior checkpoint.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False - a staffed booth is present, so not a remote/kiosk gate.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Deep paved approach and apron between the road-edge entrance, the interior gate, and the drop yard / docks holds many trucks.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Approach from English Ave to the interior gate is deep (>3 truck lengths) and the signalized entrance keeps queues off the public road.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide gate apron with an inbound/outbound split around the booth island and ample unused paved width to add a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.entryExitTogether: Single entrance point on English Ave for both in and out; the booth island splits directions internally at one location.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: ~1 controlled inbound lane at the booth; estimated from overhead - flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.exitLanes: ~1 controlled outbound lane at the booth; estimated from overhead - flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 50+ - long banks of dock doors with trailers backed in on the SE face (~30+) and NE face plus the SE annex building; total well over 50.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 50+ - very large dedicated drop yard north and west of the main building, dozens of rows of parked bobtailed trailers.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Distinct dock banks on separate building faces (SE face and NE face) plus the SE annex, consistent with separate ship/receive operations.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Inside the Indianapolis metro (Irvington/east side), surrounded by interstate interchange and industrial development.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Main warehouse plus a SE annex/cross-dock building and a separate west office/support building - a campus.
fieldNotes.railServed: A mainline rail runs parallel just outside the SE property line but no spur enters the property; trucks-only operation.
fieldNotes.scale: No clear truck scale/weigh pad identified in the gate path; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer-storage yard separate from active dock staging, full of parked trailers.
fieldNotes.operator: Operated for Kroger by Zenith Logistics (24+ yrs); facility phone 317-352-5100.
